# Load data

```{r}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

#read in data
data <- read.csv("06_cleandata/combined_plot_data.csv")
```

# Practice plotting data to see if data frame is set up correctly

```{r}


#number NSQ vs % bare ground
ggplot(data, aes(x = bare, y = bumble_bees)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Bumble Bees vs. % Bare Ground",
       x = "% Bare Ground",
       y = "Number of Bumble Bees") +
  theme_minimal()

```
